answer: Give operators a legal door. Anyone may declare every ID they run, and a declared cluster of N IDs is paid as one ID times log2(N+1): 100 clones earn about 6.7x, not 100x, and keep it. A hidden cluster later linked by audits forfeits all pay still locked. Like an opal whose fire shows only when tilted, a farm looks fine until one audit turns it, and the longer it hides, the more it risks. Declaring buys a steady oasis; hiding rides a comet that burns up when caught. The log curve is a design choice I picked, not a measurement.
